description: Runtime knobs. Edit freely; the routine reads these on every run. No code changes needed — all thresholds live here.

macro_kill_switches._comment_vix: If VIX closes above this level, post kill-switch message and stop — no ticker analysis.

vix_thresholds._comment: Shapes position-sizing notes in the Slack output. Kill-switch is in macro_kill_switches.vix_max above.

confluence._comment_counter_trend: Counter-trend setups (weekly bear + daily bull) require 5/6 instead of 4/6.
confluence._comment_post_earnings: First signal on a ticker after earnings blackout ends requires 5/6 for one day.
confluence._comment_max_signals: If more than 3 tickers qualify, rank by confluence score, then pattern-tag count, then historical-analog hit rate.

risk._comment: Applied at the risk-gate step in SKILL.md. ATR multiples follow the Renaissance approach of volatility-normalised stops.
risk._comment_sizing: Confidence note in Slack message: HIGH confidence (5-6/6) = full size; MEDIUM (4/6) = half size.

earnings._comment: Counts trading days only (Mon-Fri excluding NYSE holidays). Day 0 = earnings day itself.

data_pull._comment: Alpha Vantage call budget. Free tier = 25/day; paid = 500+. Adjust lookbacks if rate-limited.
data_pull._comment_rate_limit: If Alpha Vantage returns rate-limit errors, skip that ticker and add it to the failures list in the Slack footer. Do not retry in the same run.

pattern_recognition._comment_analog: Historical analog note only shown if 3+ prior occurrences exist in the lookback window.
